assessment_policy: No assessment prediction or metrics in this pilot. Validation selects checkpoints and rates; its scores are exploratory.
features: Current own belief and model/role identity, current round, own degree, visible neighbor belief and model/role identities. No question ID/text, ground truth, future states, or source-model probability vectors.
baseline_policy: Empirical Markov transitions; published-style local-composition logistic; local-composition plus receiver-identity logistic; full available role-by-belief aggregate logistic. Original signed binary Ising is not directly applied to these unsigned, three-category interactions.
neural_policy: Both families receive the same available information. The pooled model receives exact role-by-belief counts/fractions, which fully describe the visible multiset in this protocol. Four-head, width-eight attention is adapted from the original architecture, with native labels and unsigned edges; actual parameter count is reported.
